seo.title: Situations — Resolve Advisory
seo.description: While every situation is unique, these are some of the circumstances that most often lead people to seek help.

hero.label: Situations
hero.heading: Every situation is unique.
paragraphs: While every situation is unique, these are some of the circumstances that most often lead people to seek help.

cards.title: Business Disputes
cards.body: Disagreements between partners involving trust, communication, decision-making, ownership, or the future direction of a business.

cards.title: Leadership and Ownership Changes
cards.body: Founder conflict, succession challenges, leadership transitions, governance questions, or competing visions for the future.

cards.title: Family Conflict
cards.body: Estrangement, inheritance and estate disputes, communication breakdowns, caregiving responsibilities, and long-standing family tensions.

cards.title: Divorce and Separation
cards.body: Complex financial, parenting, and relationship dynamics that benefit from calm judgment and thoughtful strategy.

cards.title: Investor Conflicts
cards.body: Tensions involving investors, capital partners, financial expectations, control, transparency, or alignment of interests.

cards.title: Ongoing Advisory
cards.body: Situations that benefit from ongoing perspective and strategic guidance over time.

closingCta.text: If your situation is not listed, it's still worth a conversation.
